mapper.select: SELECT id FROM afv_generation_submission WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_generation_submission(id, request_id, scope_key, request_hash, kind, task_id, public_task_id, actor_user_id, actor_team_id, project_id, canvas_node_run_id, context_json, model_snapshot_json, api_config_id, api_config_hash, state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.scopeKey}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.kind}, #{row.taskId}, #{row.publicTaskId}, #{row.actorUserId}, #{row.actorTeamId}, #{row.projectId}, #{row.canvasNodeRunId}, #{row.contextJson}, #{row.modelSnapshotJson}, #{row.apiConfigId}, #{row.apiConfigHash}, 'QUEUED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_generation_submission SET state = #{state}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id FROM afv_generation_submission s WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.canvas_node_run_id = #{nodeRunId} AND s.state IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_remote_generation_job j WHERE j.submission_id = s.id AND (j.permit_held = TRUE OR j.state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','PARTIAL_FAILED','FAILED','CANCELLED')))
